cosign-verify-init/dockerfile.candidate: Two-stage build with a separate fetch stage
Base image alpine:3.24 pinned by sha256 digest
apk packages curl and ca-certificates pinned to exact versions
ca-certificates installed in the runtime image for TLS to registries
cosign binary installed at /usr/local/bin/cosign with mode 0755
VERSION-BUMP marker comment for automated version bumps

cosign-verify-init/makefile.candidate: Running make with no target prints the list of targets and their descriptions
make setup installs the pre-commit hook
make build builds the image tagged IMAGE:VERSION with COSIGN_VERSION set to VERSION (default 3.1.3)
make lint runs every pre-commit hook against all files
make test builds the image, then runs test.sh against it
make install pulls the published image at VERSION
make run builds the image, then runs verify-images with ARGS
make format runs the whitespace, end-of-file and line-ending fixer hooks and ignores their non-zero exits
make analyze refuses with exit 69 and an install hint when trivy is missing, otherwise scans for CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and secrets
make push builds, then pushes IMAGE:VERSION
make release builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 and pushes both the VERSION and latest tags

cosign-verify-init/test.candidate: Smoke test checks that the image runs `cosign version`
Smoke test makes its temp key dir world-readable for uid 10001 and generates a key pair inside the image
Smoke test requires an image:tag argument and prints usage otherwise
Smoke test pulls alpine:3.22 and resolves its repo digest as the unsigned fixture
Smoke test prints PASS / FAIL with the observed exit code and cleans up its temp dir (leaves it behind if an earlier docker step fails under set -e)
A digest-pinned image not signed by the trusted key blocks the workload

cosign-verify-init/test-validation.candidate: Stub cosign that records its operands to a calls file
Temporary directory created and removed on exit or signal
Test prints PASS/FAIL lines and exits 1 on an accepted invalid reference
No cosign call happens when validation fails
Any image reference that is not repository@sha256 with 64 lowercase hex characters refuses the whole list before anything is verified
Digest-pinned references, with or without a tag, are each verified exactly as given
An image reference shaped like a command-line option is verified as an image, never obeyed as an option

cosign-verify-init/verify-images.candidate: cosign stdout is discarded and stderr buffered to /tmp/err before replay
KEYLESS enabled only by the exact value true
Smoke test: cosign version runs inside the image
Per-image progress messages as their own rule

docs/stylesheets.candidate: Translucent blurred header with hairline divider and shadow on scroll
Tab link opacity and active weight
Tables styled as rounded cards with uppercase headers (overflow:hidden on the table; horizontal scrolling comes from Material's wrapper)
Hero block centred layout and tagline sizing
Feature cards with rounded borders, hover lift and accent-coloured icons
Sidebar nav title and active link weight
Footer background, divider and muted link colour
Material primary colour variables wired to the accent pair

cosign-verify-init/test.rule: image-verification.gate.unsigned-image-blocks-workload: an image pinned by digest that is not signed by the trusted key makes the init container exit 1 (signature refusal, separate from the 64 for a rejected reference), so the workload never starts
